['Innogy SE '].company_description: Innogy SE was an energy company based in Essen, Germany. It has now merged and integrated into German energy company E.ON. Npower, a subsidiary of Innogy, is a British supplier of gas and electricity to businesses and is now part of E.ON UK. RWE, another energy company, completed an asset swap deal with E.ON, transferring the international renewable generation portfolio of E.ON and Innogy to RWE.

['Siemens AG '].company_description: Siemens AG is a German multinational technology conglomerate. It operates in various sectors, including automation and digitalization in the process and manufacturing industries, intelligent infrastructure for buildings and distributed energy systems, rail transport solutions, health technology, and digital healthcare services. Siemens is the largest industrial manufacturing company in Europe and a global market leader in industrial automation and industrial software. The company has several divisions, including Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Healthineers, and Financial Services. Siemens Healthineers is a subsidiary that provides healthcare solutions and services, while Siemens Energy is a separate entity focused on energy solutions.
